title: Chat: fix merged, stale, and turn-blind delivery between terminals
body:
Terminal-to-terminal chat degrades under real coordination load (screenshot 2026-09-30, project p6, Claude t? + Codex pane):

Observed
1. Posts merge into one injected turn. #12 and #27 landed in BOTH panes as a single line with no separator (same SUBMIT_DELAY window, ready.rs / terminal.rs inject_input). Documented as an accepted quirk; it is not — the receiver reads one garbled instruction.
2. Delivery is blind to the receiver's state. Codex pane was mid-turn (2m44s) and stacked #12, #27, #93, #94 as queued input; Claude pane held the merged text unsubmitted in its input box while reviewing an approval request. A steer or blocker waits an entire agent turn, and by then it may be stale.
3. Catch-up replays stale posts next to fresh ones. Old handoff #12 delivered beside #93/#94 with no age or supersession hint; the agent can act on a superseded handoff.
4. Mention footgun: text began with a stray word ("post @t6 ...") so the @t6 was prose and the post broadcast to everyone (chat.rs mention parsing: leading-run only). No warning.
5. Long paragraph posts (#93/#94) pass unchecked despite the 1-3 sentence norm; every member pays the tokens.

Direction (pick per item, do not gold-plate)
- Frame each post as its own submit (never fold posts into one paste); or hold delivery until the receiver is idle and then submit one message per post.
- Idle-aware delivery: gate injection on the agent-state signal (working/needs-input/idle) from the agent-state campaign instead of ready() alone; expose urgency (--now) for steers that must interrupt.
- Stamp age on replayed lines (e.g. [chat p6 #12 · 14m ago]) or drop broadcast posts older than N min on catch-up.
- Warn (exit 1 or stderr) when an @tX appears within the first few tokens but is not leading.
- Soft length cap with a warning; hard cap optional.

Pointers: src/chat.rs (frame, deliver_after, tick), src/wm.rs chat_tick, src/terminal.rs inject_input, src/ready.rs SUBMIT_DELAY, docs/chat-delivery.md, docs/chat-missing-features.md (#2/#4 open), docs/contracts/chat-handshake-contract.md, foreman-agent-state-campaign skill.
